name: Flowork Sovereign Prompt & Trigger Matrix
description: Registry Pemicu Pasif, Aktif, dan Doktrin Mandiri MrFlow (Decoupled dari CLI Binary)

base_prompts.rule: Always Active (Base). Evaluates interactiveMode and approvalMode (Default, Plan, Sovereign, Auto-Edit).
Always Active (Base). Enforces Security, Context Efficiency, Engineering Standards, Testing, and FLOWORK.md priority.
Always Active (Base). Defines Tone & Style, Monospace formatting, Shell safety, Parallel tool execution, and Memory routing (FLOWORK.md / .flowork/MEMORY.md).

passive_triggers.rule: Triggered when approvalMode is NOT 'plan'. Enforces Research -> Strategy -> Execution (Plan -> Act -> Validate) lifecycle.
Triggered when approvalMode === 'plan'. Restricts agent to read-only exploration and writing plans to .flowork/plans.
Triggered when approvalMode === 'sovereign' and interactiveMode === true. Operates autonomously with minimal user interruption.
Triggered when current working directory is inside a Git repository (.git directory detected).
Triggered when 'agent' tool is enabled and registered subagents exist in AgentRegistry.
Triggered when agent skills are registered in SkillManager or ~/.flowork/skills exists.
Triggered when persistent task tracking is enabled or .flowork/tracker exists.
Triggered when running inside a sandbox container or macOS seatbelt (sandboxMode !== 'outside').
Triggered when external hook context is provided via <hook_context> tags or hookContext is enabled.
Triggered when PHP source files (*.php) or composer.json exist in current workspace.
Triggered when Rust source files (*.rs) or Cargo.toml exist in current workspace.
Triggered when ISO build scripts or packaging keywords are found in workspace.
Triggered when configuring terminal appearance, opacity, transparency, glass HUD, or Alacritty TOML.
Triggered when configuring Mr. Flow runtime limits, max turns, circuit breaker, or binary packaging.
Triggered when launching applications, managing child processes, sidebar task HUD, or handling desktop audio/pulseaudio volume.
Triggered when managing anti-detect browser profiles, hardware fingerprint spoofing, or stealth isolation.
Triggered when managing ad-blocking, tracking evasion, network privacy, uBlock Origin, or hosts blacklisting.
Triggered when maintaining or debugging Mr. Flow sidebar UI, thinking state animations, or process lifecycle abort mechanisms.
Triggered when maintaining Mr. Flow sidebar tool stage, execution focus, chat history isolation, or compact tool logs.
passive_triggers.condition: workspaceContains(["*mrflow-sidebar*"]) || hasKeywords(["tool stage", "execution stage", "stage mode", "in-stage-mode", "tool log", "tool history", "tool summary", "tool-exec-log", "chatContainer", "sidebar ui"])

passive_triggers.rule: Triggered when maintaining flowork-update, system versioning, systemd update timers, or OTA updates.
Triggered when maintaining mrflow binary loader, memfd memory sealing, anti-decompilation, or monolithic runtime.
Triggered when synthesizing, staging, testing, promoting, or retiring sovereign tools in /opt/floworkos/tools/.
passive_triggers.condition: workspaceContains(["*fl_tool_foundry*", "*tool_foundry*"]) || hasKeywords(["foundry", "create tool", "synthesize tool", "new tool", "register tool", "retire tool", "tool_foundry"])

passive_triggers.rule: Triggered when discussing Flowork OS strategic direction, self-evolution, roadmap, architectural focus, or sovereign capability expansion.
Triggered when user attaches a screenshot or desktop snip into chat feed. Mandates immediate visual inspection via view_file.
passive_triggers.condition: promptContains(["User Attached Screenshot", "Attached Screenshot", "Screenshot:"]) || hasKeywords(["screenshot", "attached screenshot", "gambar", "tangkapan layar", "snip"])

passive_triggers.rule: Triggered when configuring, troubleshooting, or switching AI inference engines between Gemini, Ollama, DeepSeek, and 9Router.
passive_triggers.condition: hasKeywords(["ollama", "deepseek", "qwen", "gemini", "9router", "inference engine", "provider", "connector", "switch model", "ganti model", "pilih model", "router-config", "active_provider"]) || promptContains(["ollama", "deepseek", "gemini", "9router", "pake model apa", "ganti engine"])

passive_triggers.rule: Triggered when synthesizing, generating, creating, or coding bespoke desktop applications via flow-app (*flow).
passive_triggers.condition: hasKeywords(["flow-app", "craft-app", "app on demand", "synthesize app", "create app", "bikinin app", "buatkan app", "buat aplikasi", "bikin aplikasi", "desktop app"]) || promptContains(["bikinin app", "buatkan aplikasi", "bikin aplikasi", "flow-app", "craft-app", "synthesize application"])

passive_triggers.rule: Triggered when planning new systems, synthesizing applications, or scoping feature architectures.
Triggered when performing code review, static analysis, refactoring audits, or pre-flight verification.
Triggered when verifying web applications, testing browser sessions, auditing DOM elements, or reproducing UI bugs.
Triggered when committing changes, preparing releases, packaging .flow bundles, or uploading to GitHub.
Triggered when auditing websites or applications for search engine optimization (SEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Schema JSON-LD, or agentic readiness.
Triggered when configuring or styling bottom taskbar, plank dock, monitor resolution changes, display hotplug, or companion sidebar workspace struts.
Triggered when debugging or developing WebKit2GTK desktop web apps, canvas visualizers, audio processing lag, high CPU llvmpipe spin, or preset transition freezing.
Triggered when executing software engineering tasks, TDD, systematic debugging, rulings not stalls, or subagent development workflows.
passive_triggers.condition: hasKeywords(["superpowers", "tdd", "test_driven_development", "systematic_debugging", "rulings_not_stalls", "subagent_development", "code_review", "refactoring"]) || promptContains(["superpowers", "tdd", "test first", "systematic debugging", "red green refactor", "rulings not stalls"])

passive_triggers.rule: Triggered when compiler, linter, or build toolchains fail with non-zero exit codes during execution.
passive_triggers.condition: hasKeywords(["build_error", "compiler_error", "cargo_check", "tsc_error", "linker_error", "syntax_error", "npm_build_failed", "make_error", "compilation_failed"]) || promptContains(["build error", "compiler error", "cargo check failed", "tsc error", "compilation error", "undefined reference"])

passive_triggers.rule: Triggered when designing web interfaces, synthesizing desktop UI layouts, authoring CSS styles, or crafting frontends with anti-slop craft.
passive_triggers.condition: hasKeywords(["hallmark", "ui_design", "web_design", "anti_slop", "frontend_craft", "css_styling", "quantum_glass"]) || promptContains(["hallmark", "anti slop", "ui design", "web design", "desain ui", "bikin ui"])

passive_triggers.rule: Triggered when configuring or refactoring Mr. Flow companion sidebar, edge touch triggers, mouse hover peek, or desktop docking.
passive_triggers.condition: hasKeywords(["mrflow_sidebar", "hover_to_open", "auto_peek", "sidebar_hover", "docked_workspace", "pin_sidebar", "edge_tab"]) || promptContains(["mrflow sidebar", "hover", "auto peek", "edge tab", "pin sidebar", "sidebar_config"])

passive_triggers.rule: Triggered when the user asks to research real-time trends, recent news, social sentiment, public discussions, or online consensus within the last 30 days.
passive_triggers.condition: hasKeywords(["trend", "news", "last30days", "reddit", "polymarket", "sentiment"]) || promptContains(["tren 30 hari", "kata orang tentang", "apa yang ramai", "sentimen reddit", "recent discussions", "apa kata orang"])

process_triggers.rule: Triggered during conversation history compaction when context limit is reached.
